name: Shady Rest Inn
summary: At the Shady Rest Inn, smoke and blackened beams mark the place where travelers once stopped between the Barrens and Theramore Isle. Fire left the inn in ruins and its keeper shattered. Theramore's investigators search the wreckage for clues.

sections.title: Ashes on the Border
sections.body: Travelers once found shelter at the Shady Rest Inn between Dustwallow Marsh and the Barrens. Then a sudden fire burned it to the ground. Innkeeper James Hyal survived, but his wife and child died in the blaze. Grief and trauma have left him with nothing. Now Theramore's authorities search the ruins for whoever lit the fire.

sections.title: A Web of Suspicion
sections.body: Early inquiries blamed human deserters and suspicious soldiers. Paval Reethe and Lieutenant Caldwell drew heavy suspicion, then met untimely ends. Hoofprints and ritual badges in the ashes revealed the attackers: ruthless Grimtotem tauren. They struck from the deep marsh to sow discord between Theramore and its neighbors.

faq.q: What happened to the Shady Rest Inn?
aliases: why is shady rest inn burned
faq.answer: An attack burned the Shady Rest Inn to the ground. Investigators first suspected deserters and rogue Alliance soldiers, and still search the ashes for clues to the arsonists.

faq.q: Who owned and operated the inn?
faq.answer: James Hyal ran the Shady Rest Inn. He survived the blaze, but his wife and child died in the flames, leaving him deeply traumatized.

faq.q: Where is the Shady Rest Inn located?
faq.answer: The Shady Rest Inn's ruins lie beside the main road in western Dustwallow Marsh, near the border with the Barrens.

faq.q: Who are Paval Reethe and Lieutenant Caldwell?
faq.answer: Paval Reethe and Lieutenant Caldwell were human suspects in the early fire investigation. Both died before investigators could get confessions or learn the full extent of their involvement.

angles.text: The inn's destruction left a breach in security along the main overland route to Theramore Isle. Travelers face danger, and fears of hidden enemies are rising.
Suspicion over the inn fire threatens the fragile peace between the Horde and Jaina Proudmoore's forces in Dustwallow Marsh.
